1.title: 5 Rules for Building AI Agents That Work in Production | Nan Yu & Jacob Shumway
1.author: Peter Yang
1.hook: Linear built a production agent that moves work from Slack to code in 6 minutes; Nan and Jacob walk through the memo, tooling strategy, and eval approach end-to-end.

2.title: Claude ran a business in our office
2.author: Anthropic
2.hook: Claude autonomously ran a real small business (vending operation) in Anthropic's office for most of 2025, revealing both how close AI agents came to success and specific failure modes in real-world execution.

3.title: Grok Bot + Grok 4.6  + Cursor Origin - is Claude Code dead?
3.author: How I AI
3.hook: Hands-on comparison of Grok Bot (multi-account connectors), Cursor Origin, and Grok 4.6 model against Claude and GPT, with concrete verdicts on what actually ships vs. hype.

4.title: Instinct vs Grok Bot vs ChatGPT vs Hermes: Which AI Agent Can You Trust?
4.author: Peter Yang
4.hook: First-hand comparison of four AI agents (Instinct, Grok Bot, ChatGPT, Hermes) with access to email, documents, logins, and purchase authority — plus prompt injection vulnerability demo.

5.title: Muse gets AI agent UX right
5.author: How I AI
5.hook: First-pass test of Meta's Muse personal AI agent across calendar, goals, newsletter generation, shopping, and avatar design — with explicit comparison to Claude, Codex, and other agents on UX specifics.

6.title: New! Amazon Tags in YouTube Shopping, Views (Co-Viewed), Branded Content Updates
6.author: Creator Insider
6.hook: Three named YouTube platform changes for creators — Amazon Tags in Shopping, Views (Co-Viewed) stat, and branded content policy updates with auto-labeling.

7.title: The Age Of The 40-Year-Old Solo Founder Is Here
7.author: Y Combinator
7.hook: 40-year-old founder rebuilding Webflow's success with an AI-native marketing platform; chapters on competitive moats, purpose-built AI vs. better models, and agents as customers (CLI, MCP, AEO).

8.title: Two Bugs That Hid in Plain Sight: A vLLM Debugging Detective Story — Asaf Gardin & Yuval Belfer
8.author: AI Engineer
8.hook: Two production bugs in vLLM with Mamba models that returned high-confidence gibberish under load — found via request ID threading and logprob forensics, not crash logs.

9.title: Weight Folding, CUDA Streams, and the Bug That Made My Model Speak Backwards — Filip Makraduli
9.author: AI Engineer
9.hook: A kernel-level optimization (weight folding + deferred division) that buys 33–35% speedup on RMS norm + projection, with a detailed account of a race condition bug in parallel CUDA streams and how to fix it.

10.title: YPP Updates, View Count Changes, and more | Creator Roundup
10.author: YouTube Creators
10.hook: Official YouTube platform announcements on view count metrics changes, YPP eligibility updates, and new creator monetization/tagging features.
